ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~16 day(s) ago @ 17.43) and momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over. ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early topping signs (heads-up): MACD histogram rolled over off a peak (pre-cross). These anticipate a high BEFORE confirmation — a heads-up to protect gains, not a sell trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 16 天前形成 @ 17.43）且动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 14 周 · 日线周期第 28 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（趋势不明）：混合。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
